# Language Features: Randomization

Random numbers and their seed.

Random numbers. The generator gives the same numbers every time a program starts, unless [SeedRnd](SeedRnd) is given a different seed, such as the time from [MilliSecs](MilliSecs).

Back to [Language Features](Language-Features) or the [Command Index](Command-Index).

* [Rand](Rand)
* [Rnd](Rnd)
* [RndSeed](RndSeed)
* [SeedRnd](SeedRnd)
